## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated files.
- [ ] Authorization, validation, sanitization, and escaping were reviewed.
- [ ] Database queries remain prepared, indexed, and bounded.
- [ ] WooCommerce order access uses public CRUD APIs.
- [ ] Tests cover behavior changes and failure paths.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog entries are updated where needed.
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, local logs, or generated archives are included.
